description_target.target_text: Find the shortest path from the start to the goal while collecting key 4 before door 6 and key 5 before door 7. Output only the path cells in maroon(9).

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))

    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (bbox< a b)
      (cond [(not (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))]
            [(not (= (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))) (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))]
            [(not (= (obj-r2 a) (obj-r2 b))) (< (obj-r2 a) (obj-r2 b))]
            [else (< (obj-c2 a) (obj-c2 b))]))
    (define (object-grid grid obj)
      (subgrid grid (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj)))
    (define (crop-nz grid)
      (crop-to-content grid 0))
    (define (transform-key grid key)
      (cond [(= key 1) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= key 2) (flip-lr grid)]
            [(= key 3) (flip-ud grid)]
            [(= key 4) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [else grid]))
    (define (norm-cells cells)
      (let ((r0 (apply min (map first cells)))
            (c0 (apply min (map second cells))))
        (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) r0) (- (second p) c0))) cells) cell<)))
    (define (shape-key obj)
      (norm-cells (obj-cells obj)))
    (define (crop-cells cells [color 8])
      (if (empty? cells)
          (grid (list 0))
          (let* ((norm (norm-cells cells))
                 (h (+ 1 (apply max (map first norm))))
                 (w (+ 1 (apply max (map second norm)))))
            (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0) norm color))))
    (define (component-perimeter obj)
      (let ((cells (obj-cells obj)))
        (for/sum ([p (in-list cells)])
          (count-where (lambda (d)
                         (not (member (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d))) cells)))
                       cardinal-deltas))))
    (define (scan-frames grid frame-color)
      (define (border-ok r0 c0 r1 c1)
        (and (= (at grid r0 c0) frame-color)
             (= (at grid r0 c1) frame-color)
             (= (at grid r1 c0) frame-color)
             (= (at grid r1 c1) frame-color)
             (all? (lambda (c) (and (= (at grid r0 c) frame-color) (= (at grid r1 c) frame-color)))
                   (range c0 (+ c1 1)))
             (all? (lambda (r) (and (= (at grid r c0) frame-color) (= (at grid r c1) frame-color)))
                   (range r0 (+ r1 1)))))
      (filter (lambda (x) (not (eq? x #f)))
        (for*/list ([r0 (in-range 0 (- (rows grid) 2))]
                    [c0 (in-range 0 (- (cols grid) 2))]
                    [r1 (in-range (+ r0 2) (rows grid))]
                    [c1 (in-range (+ c0 2) (cols grid))])
          (if (border-ok r0 c0 r1 c1)
              (list r0 c0 r1 c1)
              #f))))
    (define (fr-r0 fr) (first fr))
    (define (fr-c0 fr) (second fr))
    (define (fr-r1 fr) (third fr))
    (define (fr-c1 fr) (fourth fr))
    (define (fr-area fr) (* (- (fr-r1 fr) (fr-r0 fr)) (- (fr-c1 fr) (fr-c0 fr))))
    (define (frame-border-cells fr)
      (remove-duplicates
       (append (for/list ([c (in-range (fr-c0 fr) (+ (fr-c1 fr) 1))]) (list (fr-r0 fr) c))
               (for/list ([c (in-range (fr-c0 fr) (+ (fr-c1 fr) 1))]) (list (fr-r1 fr) c))
               (for/list ([r (in-range (fr-r0 fr) (+ (fr-r1 fr) 1))]) (list r (fr-c0 fr)))
               (for/list ([r (in-range (fr-r0 fr) (+ (fr-r1 fr) 1))]) (list r (fr-c1 fr))))))
    (define (draw-frame out fr)
      (paint-cells out (frame-border-cells fr) 8))
    (define (center-paste out crop fr)
      (let* ((ih (- (fr-r1 fr) (fr-r0 fr) 1))
             (iw (- (fr-c1 fr) (fr-c0 fr) 1))
             (top (+ (fr-r0 fr) 1 (quotient (- ih (rows crop)) 2)))
             (left (+ (fr-c0 fr) 1 (quotient (- iw (cols crop)) 2))))
        (for*/fold ([acc out])
                   ([r (in-range (rows crop))]
                    [c (in-range (cols crop))])
          (let ((v (at crop r c)))
            (if (= v 0) acc (set-cell acc (+ top r) (+ left c) v))))))
    (define (binary grid)
      (map-grid grid (lambda (r c v) (if (= v 0) 0 1))))
    (define (dihedral-variants grid)
      (remove-duplicates
       (append
        (for/list ([k (in-range 4)])
          (let loop ([n k] [cur grid])
            (if (= n 0) cur (loop (- n 1) (rotate-cw cur)))))
        (for/list ([k (in-range 4)])
          (let loop ([n k] [cur (flip-lr grid)])
            (if (= n 0) cur (loop (- n 1) (rotate-cw cur))))))))
    (define (shape-place out crop top left)
      (for*/fold ([acc out])
                 ([r (in-range (rows crop))]
                  [c (in-range (cols crop))])
        (let ((v (at crop r c)))
          (if (= v 0) acc (set-cell acc (+ top r) (+ left c) v)))))
    (define (grid-crop-to-content grid cells)
      (subgrid grid
               (apply min (map first cells))
               (apply min (map second cells))
               (apply max (map first cells))
               (apply max (map second cells))))
    (define (apply-boolean a b op)
      (let* ((h (max (rows a) (rows b)))
             (w (max (cols a) (cols b)))
             (raw (grid-from-fn h w
                    (lambda (r c)
                      (let ((aa (and (< r (rows a)) (< c (cols a)) (not (= (at a r c) 0))))
                            (bb (and (< r (rows b)) (< c (cols b)) (not (= (at b r c) 0)))))
                        (if (cond [(= op 4) (or aa bb)]
                                  [(= op 5) (and aa bb)]
                                  [(= op 6) (not (equal? aa bb))]
                                  [else #f])
                            8
                            0)))))
             (cells (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at raw (first p) (second p)) 0))) (grid-positions raw))))
        (if (empty? cells) (grid (list 0)) (grid-crop-to-content raw cells))))

    (define start (first (find-color g 2)))
    (define goal (first (find-color g 3)))
    (define start-state (list (first start) (second start) 0 0))
    (define prev (make-hash))
    (define queue (list start-state))
    (define end-state #f)
    (hash-set! prev start-state #f)
    (define (passable nr nc ka kb)
      (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
           (not (= (at g nr nc) 8))
           (or (not (= (at g nr nc) 6)) (= ka 1))
           (or (not (= (at g nr nc) 7)) (= kb 1))))
    (define (bfs)
      (unless (or end-state (empty? queue))
        (define st (first queue))
        (set! queue (rest queue))
        (define r (first st))
        (define c (second st))
        (define ka (third st))
        (define kb (fourth st))
        (if (and (= r (first goal)) (= c (second goal)))
            (set! end-state st)
            (let ((nka (if (= (at g r c) 4) 1 ka))
                  (nkb (if (= (at g r c) 5) 1 kb)))
              (if (and (not (and (= nka ka) (= nkb kb))) (not (hash-has-key? prev (list r c nka nkb))))
                  (begin
                    (hash-set! prev (list r c nka nkb) st)
                    (set! queue (cons (list r c nka nkb) queue)))
                  (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
                    (define nr (+ r (first d)))
                    (define nc (+ c (second d)))
                    (when (passable nr nc nka nkb)
                      (define ns (list nr nc nka nkb))
                      (unless (hash-has-key? prev ns)
                        (hash-set! prev ns st)
                        (set! queue (append queue (list ns)))))))))
        (bfs)))
    (bfs)
    (if (not end-state)
        (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)
        (let rebuild ([cur end-state] [out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
          (if (eq? cur #f)
              out
              (rebuild (hash-ref prev cur #f) (set-cell out (first cur) (second cur) 9)))))
  ))
